| **Government Experience** | Critical in Canberra — check for ASD/IRAP compliance familiarity |
| **Local Presence** | On-the-ground Canberra consultants vs. remote-only |
| **Track Record** | Years in operation, client testimonials, case studies |
| **Managed Services** | Ongoing support vs. one-off project delivery |

> ⚠️ **Note:** Canberra's market is heavily government-focused, so it's worth asking any prospective partner about their experience with Australian Government security frameworks (e.g., ISM, PROTECTED environments) and whether they hold relevant government panel arrangements (e.g., Digital Transformation Agency panels). Always request references before engaging.
